about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about building software that matters
bio: Hi, I'm Brandon, a Full-Stack developer from Concepción, Chile, and a Computer Science Engineering student.

I specialize in building web applications, automating processes and integrating systems to help companies work more efficiently. My goal is not just to write software, but to deliver solutions that simplify daily work, reduce errors and create real value.

I've worked on projects in the healthcare sector, building platforms that automate critical processes and integrate multiple systems into a single application. I've also worked on AI-based solutions, applying computer vision and AI models to solve real problems, such as the automatic validation of progress in construction projects.
One of these projects earned first place in Open Innovation AVA x UCSC 2026, an innovation competition focused on solving real industry challenges.
I work with technologies such as Laravel, PHP, React, Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Docker, always prioritizing secure, scalable and maintainable applications.

I believe a good technology solution should be reliable, easy to use and designed for the people who will use it. If you have an idea or a process you want to digitize, I'd love to help you turn it into a useful, high-quality solution.

gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.title: Hospital account management
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.stackDescription: Backend built with PHP 8.2 and MySQL, with a Bootstrap, jQuery and DataTables interface. Integration through Playwright (Node.js) to automate external systems, plus PHPMailer, PhpSpreadsheet and Docker deployment.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.problem: Creating accounts required entering the same information across different systems, performing manual validations and managing multiple requests, causing delays and increasing the risk of errors.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.solution: I built a portal that centralizes the whole process in a single form. The system validates employee information, manages permissions, integrates multiple platforms and automates account creation, activation and deactivation through controlled workflows.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.results:
Automated account provisioning process.
Internal and external system integration.
Reduced operational times and errors.
Secure management with authentication and role-based access.

motor-validacion-ia.title: Validation Platform
motor-validacion-ia.description: Smart platform to validate construction progress using artificial intelligence
motor-validacion-ia.intro: A web system built to verify that the progress reported in construction projects matches the real state of the site. The platform analyzes on-site photographs, daily reports and the project plan to automatically validate progress or flag it for review when there is uncertainty.
motor-validacion-ia.award: Winning project — first place in Open Innovation AVA x UCSC 2026.
motor-validacion-ia.stackDescription: Built with Laravel (PHP), React and PostgreSQL, integrating Google Gemini Flash for image and report analysis. It also uses Python for data processing and an API-based architecture for communication between its modules.
motor-validacion-ia.problem: In construction projects, progress is usually based on reports sent from the field, with no objective way to verify that the photographic evidence supports the reported progress. This makes project tracking difficult and increases the risk of errors in decision-making.
motor-validacion-ia.solution: I built a platform that integrates the project plan, daily reports and photographic evidence into a single workflow. Using artificial intelligence, the system analyzes each report and calculates a confidence level to automatically validate progress or flag it for review when needed.
motor-validacion-ia.results:
Automated validation of construction progress using AI.
Integration of planning, reports and photographic evidence.
Reduced time spent on manual reviews.
Greater reliability in project progress tracking.
